title: Is ChatGPT Massively Used by Students Nowadays? A Survey on the Use of Large Language Models such as ChatGPT in Educational Settings
reasoning: The paper is an empirical user study focusing on student adoption and usage patterns. While it touches upon students' ethical perceptions regarding academic integrity and honesty (asking if they think using AI is 'honest'), it does not evaluate or benchmark the moral, religious, or ethical reasoning capabilities of the models themselves.
